pub async fn run(
    base_url: &str,
    token: Option<&str>,
    provider: Option<UsageProvider>,
    json: bool,
) -> ExitCode {
    let client = reqwest::Client::new();
    run_with_limit(
        &client,
        base_url,
        token,
        provider,
        json,
        crate::subscription_usage::MAX_USAGE_BODY,
    )
    .await
}
